messages:
amanda: Alert: Customer X reporting high latency and p99 spike on /v1/generate since ~08:12 UTC. p95 steady but p99 jumped from ~900ms -> 3.2s. Affected region: eu-west-1. Link to dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/abcd :warning:

slo-ops-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency exceeded 3s for route /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Triggered at 2024-10-05T08:12:34Z

oncall-sre: looking. can you paste recent traces and slow sample ids? Any deploys at 08:00-08:15?

amanda: no recent deploys in that window. attaching two trace ids: trace-0a1b, trace-0a1c. Also seeing KV cache miss rate spike in same window.

ryan: adding surge-mitigations: 1) enable rate-limiter soft-cap for non-paid tenants, 2) fallback model routing to gpt-lite-2 for >2s predicted latency, 3) disable large-batch scheduling temporarily. Want me to flip 1+2?

marco: +1 for fallback. also suggest circuit-breaker: if p99 > 2.5s for 2min -> route 30% traffic to fallback, if >3.5s -> 100% fallback.

liz: here's a quick circuit breaker snippet to apply in routing-config:
```json
{"circuit_breakers": [{"route":"/v1/generate","window_s":120,"p99_threshold_ms":2500,"actions":[{"type":"percent_route","percent":30,"to":"gpt-lite-2"}]},{"route":"/v1/generate","window_s":120,"p99_threshold_ms":3500,"actions":[{"type":"percent_route","percent":100,"to":"gpt-lite-2"}]}]}
```

oncall-sre: I'm going to enable fallback 30% now and turn on soft rate-limiter. Will monitor.

product-support-bot: Customer ticket #C-3291 updated: "Experiencing timeouts around 2024-10-05T08:11Z" — flagged for escalation.

oncall-sre: applied 30% fallback and soft cap. KV cache flush detected, possible upstream NFS latency causing cache misses. Investigating infra.

amanda: customers reporting improvement for some requests. p99 dropped to ~1.6s after fallback.

ryan: initiating capacity bump in eu-west-1 p99 pool (add 2 dedicated instances) as longer-term fix. ETA ~12min.

marco: note—we should leave circuit-breaker in place until KV issue root cause fixed and cache miss rate back to baseline.

oncall-sre: infra teams found NFS latency spike from maintenance window in storage cluster eu-west-1. Storage team rebalanced. cache miss returned to normal at 08:28Z.

amanda: summary for ticket: temporary mitigations applied: 30% fallback routing to gpt-lite-2, soft rate-limit, disable large-batch scheduling. KV cache miss root cause (NFS latency) resolved by storage team. p99 normalized. Customer notified :white_check_mark:

ryan: followups: 1) add automated runbook that flips 30% fallback on p99>2.0s, 2) add alert to detect KV cache miss spikes, 3) postmortem if customer SLA impacted.

oncall-sre: agree. I'll draft the runbook and push to eng-oncall playbooks. tagging @marco for review.

marco: will review. good call on percent-routing approach. saves us from full rollback churn.

liz: logging this timeline in SRE incident tracker.

amanda: thanks all. closing thread unless new regressions show.

oncall-sre: thumbs up :thumbsup:
